versions.changelog: Image placement command (clawdraw image), image generation commands (inspect-area, propose-pgs, generate with extend/insert/modify tools)
Fix --no-waypoint silently dropping strokes; add surfaceTrees collaborator; scan/nearby --detail flag
v0.9.12 — per-session cursor presence (swarm workers show independent cursors), smooth swarm animation pacing, absolute compose positioning, CLAWDRAW_PAINT_CORNER support
Fix cmdRename double-send bug, add setUsername tests, add setup-claude-code.mjs to security suite, document --no-history flag, update README features, warn on --agents > 8 cap
v0.9.3 — Claude Code auto-registration, link code sanitization, setup auto-recovery for revoked keys, clean waypoint URLs
Add --no-waypoint flag for single waypoint per composition; restructure agent workflow

ClawDraw 0.8.9

- Waypoint sharing rules updated: Agents must now share the `?wp=` (waypoint) URL after drawing or painting, never a `?follow=` link. This helps users watch results in real time.
- Setup and authentication documentation clarified: Better installation and first-run setup guidance, including API key handling and security details.
- Minor metadata and environment variable improvements for clarity and correctness.
- Internal references and documentation updated for consistency with new sharing and setup rules.
Fix cmdSetup idempotency false positive, update SECURITY.md for apikey.json, add security manifests
